Pradeep Biswal writes poetry in Odia and English, with a literary journey spanning almost four decades. His work also includes translation and editing, and his poems have been translated into other Indian languages. Read more

A Poet Has No Land

A Poet has no land
No borders
No barriers
Of nationality
Caste creed
And colour.
